## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the reader's problem and what this change lets the reader or maintainer do.

## Verification

State the exact source commit, commands, environment, exit codes, and remaining limits.
Separate local checks from public installation and user acceptance.
Do not list a planned command as a passed check.

## Scope and privacy

- [ ] Examples and fixtures use only synthetic or public material.
- [ ] The change preserves technical facts, language, and the review-only boundary.
- [ ] Both README paths remain equivalent where affected.
- [ ] HOW_IT_WORKS.md, its diagrams, limits, and update date reflect affected product behavior.
- [ ] I ran the local checks in CONTRIBUTING.md and stated every failure or skip above.
